# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Testing Guidelines
- Use TestSprite for automated test generation and execution
- Follow PHPUnit testing standards for Laravel
- Generate comprehensive test coverage for controllers, models, and services
- Include edge cases and error handling in tests

## TestSprite Integration
- TestSprite is available via npx: `npx @testsprite/testsprite-mcp@latest`
- API Key is configured in environment
- Use TestSprite for intelligent test suggestions and coverage analysis
